rootCause: Regex requires literal trailing period (\.) on sentence limits. Sentences ending with comma, semicolon, or adjacent text fail to match.
proposedCorrection: Remove strict trailing period anchor and allow optional punctuation or sentence end (\.?\s*$|\b)

rootCause: Regex matches only at start of string (^\(Once per...\) or ^Once per...). When timing labels precede the limit without brackets, regex fails.
proposedCorrection: Permit limit extraction after stripping timing labels or unparenthesized prefixes from body

rootCause: Inline limits (', and once per turn, refresh...') are split across clause boundaries, severing the frequency restriction from the ability header.
proposedCorrection: Detect inline once per turn qualifiers during clause segmentation; attach frequency constraint to the specific clause op or promote to ability header

rootCause: Grandwalker Divine Skill costs '(Once per turn, send N cores...)' are treated purely as core payment costs and stripped, losing the once-per-turn limit.
proposedCorrection: Extract limit constraint from Divine Skill parenthetical cost blocks before delegating to cost parser

rootCause: Variations in 'of the same card name once per turn' fail to map to ONCE_PER_TURN_SAME_NAME and default to instance ONCE_PER_TURN or null.
proposedCorrection: Add comprehensive regex for all 'same card name' and 'same name' phrasing; assign header.limit = 'ONCE_PER_TURN_SAME_NAME' or 'ONCE_PER_GAME_SAME_NAME'

rootCause: Phrases like 'You can only use [Keyword] once per turn' have no parser rules and fall through completely.
proposedCorrection: Add pattern recognizing keyword-scoped limit sentences and map to ability header or keyword rule

compilerStage: Up to N Times per Turn Unrecognized
rootCause: Schema only defines binary ONCE_PER_TURN; numerical frequency restrictions ('up to twice per turn') are completely unrepresented in schema.
proposedCorrection: Support header.limit = { type: 'N_TIMES_PER_TURN', count: N } or header.limitCount parameter

rootCause: 'Once per step' or 'Once per battle' expressions are ignored because compiler only checks turn and game tokens.
proposedCorrection: Add STEP_END, BATTLE_END, and ATTACK_END limit schemas to header_parser.js
